# your version of this file under either the CDDL, the GPL Version 2 or
# to extend the choice of license to its licensees as provided above.
# However, if you add GPL Version 2 code and therefore, elected the GPL
# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is
# made subject to such option by the copyright holder.
#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`
cd "$progdir/../"

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

record.rsp_body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# This script prints the release version for emqx

# ensure dir
cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")"

if [ -f EMQX_ENTERPRISE ]; then
    EDITION='enterprise'
else
    EDITION='opensource'
fi

## emqx_release.hrl is the single source of truth for release version
RELEASE="$(grep -E "define.+EMQX_RELEASE.+${EDITION}" include/emqx_release.hrl | cut -d '"' -f2)"

git_exact_vsn() {
    local tag
    tag="$(git describe --tags --match "[e|v]*" --exact 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "${tag#[e|v]}"
}

GIT_EXACT_VSN="$(git_exact_vsn)"
if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != '' ]; then
    if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != "$RELEASE" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Tagged $GIT_EXACT_VSN, but $RELEASE in include/emqx_release.hrl" 1>&2
        exit 1
    fi
    SUFFIX=''
else
    SUFFIX="-$(git rev-parse HEAD | cut -b1-8)"
fi

echo "${RELEASE}${SUFFIX}"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*

##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*

##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}

##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"

else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"

#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#

# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5"   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR   -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR   -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR%   -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON   -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF   -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package   -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package   -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package   -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package   -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package   -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package   ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd
